command: fabio data-agent query --workspace $WS_ID --id $AGENT_ID --prompt "What are the top 5 products by revenue?"
description: Queries a published Data Agent with a natural language question over its Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint. Returns the agent's answer plus the name of the MCP tool that was invoked. Only a published agent is queryable; the draft/staging stage has no MCP endpoint.

data.question: What are the top 5 products by revenue?
data.answer: The top 5 products by revenue are: Widget Pro ($1.2M), Gadget X ($980K), SuperTool ($875K), MegaPack ($720K), BasicKit ($650K).

notes: Runtime consumption goes through the data agent's MCP server (the OpenAI Assistants API that previously backed this path was retired by OpenAI on 2026-08-26). fabio initializes the MCP session, discovers the single query tool, calls it with your prompt, and returns the text answer. Only --stage production (published, the default) is supported — a draft/sandbox agent has no MCP endpoint (publish first with `fabio data-agent publish`). The MCP URL is auto-constructed (see `fabio data-agent mcp-url`); pass --published-url only to target a specific MCP server URL (from the agent's Settings → Model Context Protocol tab). Add --raw to include the full raw MCP tool result (all content blocks + any structuredContent) in the output for debugging. Use --timeout to control max wait (default: 300s; Spark cold start can take minutes). NOTE: per-step SQL/DAX/KQL introspection, multi-turn threads, answer-file downloads, and chart-spec extraction are NOT available over the MCP surface — those were artifacts of the retired Assistants API.
